title: Understanding CEO-Employee compensation dynamics: An agent-based simulation approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.27975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: CEO compensation has often been examined from the top down, i.e., as the outcome of a negotiation between the CEO, the board of directors, and the shareholders. While these approaches have provided valuable insights into the nature of CEO compensation and its relations with firm performance and intra-firm inequality, we believe they leave aside the internal decision-making dynamics of CEOs and employees. To fill this research gap, we develop an agent-based model built on the NK framework in which a CEO compensated for long-term firm performance interacts with several employees rewarded for short-term departmental performance. This temporal dichotomy in their respective compensation functions creates a potential temporal misalignment of incentives. translated_title: 理解CEO与员工薪酬动态：基于主体的仿真方法
translated_abstract: CEO薪酬通常被自上而下地研究，即作为CEO、董事会和股东之间谈判的结果。虽然这些方法为CEO薪酬的本质及其与企业绩效和公司内部不平等之间的关系提供了宝贵的见解，但我们认为它们忽略了CEO与员工内部的决策动态。为填补这一研究空白，我们开发了一个基于NK框架的多主体模型，其中一位薪酬与企业长期绩效挂钩的CEO与多名因部门短期绩效而获得奖励的员工互动。这种各自薪酬函数上的时间二分法造成了潜在激励的时间错位。通过改变CEO做决策时所考虑的时间跨度，我们研究了这种激励的时间（错）位如何塑造企业绩效以及CEO与员工之间的薪酬不平等。
tldr: 该论文构建了基于NK框架的多主体仿真模型，揭示了CEO长期激励与员工短期激励之间的时间错位如何影响企业绩效和CEO-员工薪酬不平等。
en_tdlr: This paper develops an NK-based agent-based simulation model to reveal how the temporal misalignment between CEOs' long-term incentives and employees' short-term incentives shapes firm performance and CEO-employee pay inequality.
